title: What's new
notes: Bigger back buttons, and small touches in Me: sliding selections, a pop on ticks and values, screens that slide in.
Set when you eat under Me › Meal times. The cards and the snack reminder follow.
Me is now big buttons for each area: About you, Medication, Menu and cards, Back up, This app.
Add or change your medication under Me › Medication.
See what's coming: a control under the cards brings lunch or the snack to the top. Choose Dots or Peek under Me › See the other meals.
The menu's buttons now respond as you hold and slide your thumb. Pick a feel under Me › Menu feel.
A notification bell, top right: updates, new meals, tomorrow's shopping, low items, refills and reminders in one place.
Today is quieter: slimmer Tablet and Walk chips, and explanations only when they matter.
When daytime is done, Today now looks ahead: tonight's prep, what to pick up for tomorrow, and tomorrow's meals.
Tell the app what supper is tonight and tomorrow's first question is already answered.
Me now shows the version, with Check for updates and What's new.
